_about: SEIFA (ABS Socio-Economic Indexes for Areas) per federal electoral division, all four indexes: IRSD = Index of Relative Socio-Economic Disadvantage (pure disadvantage; HIGH score = LESS disadvantaged), IER = Index of Economic Resources, IEO = Index of Education and Occupation, IRSAD = Index of Relative Socio-Economic Advantage and Disadvantage. irsd/ier/ieo ranks run 1 = MOST disadvantaged (the APH tapes' own order); an irsad cell instead carries TWO ranks — `rank` = 1 most ADVANTAGED (the sibling pipeline's and the index's natural read), `rankDis` = 1 most disadvantaged (this store's convention, = N+1-rank). IRSAD lands from the sibling pipeline's irsad-cells.json (derive-irsad.py), which also owns the display store at .build/analysis/seifa-index/irsad-by-division.json. APH lanes carry scores/ranks as PRINTED by the papers; ABS lanes rank from their carried scores. Indexes are re-derived by the ABS per census (PCA weights recomputed), so scores and ranks compare WITHIN a census year, never across them. Census-year and boundary-edition provenance ride each election block (_provenance). 2001-census-era elections (2001, 2004) have no published four-index per-division table (AEC RR5 att1 prints IRSAD only): 2001 is the ABS's own published 2001-CED cube (scores as printed, ranks computed from them); 2013-2025 are ABS-cube derivations per 2039.0 (SA1 2011/2016 cubes x their CED allocation for 2013-2019, MB-level 2021 cube x allocation for 2022/2025), exact-verified against the ABS CED SA1-distribution cubes for 2013/2016. 2004 needs a 2001-CD to 2003-edition concordance the ABS never published. 2028 is an irsad-only forward block (2021-census derivation on the 2025 gazetted boundaries; the other three indexes await a census). 1987-1998 (five-index era) out of scope. Full map: .build/analysis/seifa-index/rr6-official-seifa-products.md.
